## Lower background overhead

- Stops terminal output polling once an exited session's final pages have been read.
- Stops the complete Live desktop session when its browser tab is hidden, ending remote capture and local decoding. Returning to the tab requires an explicit **Start**; video does not resume automatically.
- Reports decoded-video freshness only when its state changes, avoiding repeated UI updates for every frame.
- Reduces unconfigured or disabled Relay checks from every 100 milliseconds to every second. Enrollment or enablement changes can take up to one second to be noticed.
- Removes expired and revoked OAuth grants during state loading and persistence, while retaining usable grants and client registrations.
- Reads and scans H264 data in bounded chunks. A synthetic 1 MiB parser benchmark reduced processing time by approximately 95% and allocated bytes by approximately 68%. These measurements do not establish an overall battery-life improvement.

## Correctness and resource cleanup

- Serializes file uploads so repeated Upload clicks cannot interleave chunk writes and corrupt the destination.
- Prevents late terminal creation responses from replacing a different device or privilege view.
- Terminates background pipe-terminal processes even after the original command has exited, with retained process identity checks before teardown.
- Rejects malformed legacy desktop coordinates, button values, key codes and modifier types before sending host input, instead of silently converting or dropping them.
- Accepts H264 frames exactly at the size limit without counting the next frame's delimiter against that limit.
- Releases cancellation registrations for rejected duplicate Relay requests.
- Closes incomplete IPC connections immediately when the server is canceled.
- Makes Unix listener cleanup idempotent and avoids removing a replacement service's socket during restart.

## Verification and limits

The affected behavior passed 766 Go tests, 329 Dashboard tests (with one existing skipped case), relevant race checks, native builds and six-platform CLI/Kill cross-builds. Isolated macOS and Pi5 runtime fixtures verified terminal background cleanup, authenticated IPC and final output capture. Synthetic FFmpeg and frame-boundary tests verified the video parser.

Six macOS/Linux/Windows amd64/arm64 archives and `SHA256SUMS.txt` are published after native Go CI and Release CI pass for the exact tagged source. See the [source](https://github.com/jamie950315/Executor/tree/v0.4.2) and [connection instructions](https://github.com/jamie950315/Executor/blob/v0.4.2/README.md).

**Signing limits:** GitHub-built macOS apps are ad-hoc signed and not notarized. Windows binaries are not Authenticode-signed. Publication does not reinstall or restart existing devices, migrate installations, or rotate credentials.
